lines.t: In the beginning…
His voice moved across the void…
Calling light… out of darkness…
Awaken… awaken…
From the silence He speaks again
Through the void, through the end
A trembling word, a hidden flame
Through the void, through the end
A trembling word, a hidden flame
Calling every soul by name
In the dark His truth remains
He calls… from the midst of the fire
A voice like many waters…
Awake, O sleeping generation
I heard the call from the Ancient One
Burning like the rising sun
His word breaks chains, His truth resounds
Shakes the heavens, splits the ground
He is holy, He is near
Let every heart be filled with fear
And awe before His majesty
The King of all eternity
Holy! Holy! God Almighty reigns!
Fire in His eyes, forever He remains!
We rise! We rise! At the sound of His decree!
Every knee will bow—He alone is King!
“Holy! Holy! Holy!”
Woe to those who turn aside
Who love the dark and try to hide
His word is like a sharpened blade
Cuts through every lie we made
His word is like a sharpened blade
Cuts through every lie we made
Still His mercy calls us home
No more lost and no more alone
Turn and live, the hour is now
Every soul must choose and bow
Hear the trumpet, loud and clear
The day of God is drawing near
Prepare the way, make straight the path
Escape the coming wrath
Holy! Holy! God Almighty reigns!
Fire in His eyes, forever He remains!
We rise! We rise! At the sound of His decree!
Every knee will bow—He alone is King!
He is coming on the clouds
With power, with a shout
Every eye will see His face
No one will escape
Repent, return, be made new
His word is faithful, His word is true
His word is faithful, His word is true
From age to age He stays the same
YahuWah—forever His name
Lift your hands, prepare the way
The King of glory comes today
Let the nations shout His praise
Let His fire fill this place
Holy! Holy! God Almighty reigns!
Heaven and earth declare His name!
We rise! We rise! In the power of His light!
YahuShua—the truth, the way, the life!
He who was… and is… and is to come…
The Almighty… reigns…
